note: promoted after the fourth CI-blocking sighting; repro harness running: two concurrent full race suites per round, ten rounds, capturing the first real assertion text

Root cause captured from the failed CI attempt logs (runs/<id>/attempts/1/logs, byte-level assertion text): stdio rendered ag <agent> - 0s main, http rendered 1s — the swarm section leaked a live sub-second heartbeat age into state output, so byte-identity across transports raced the wall clock. Fix: heartbeat ages and lease countdowns render floored to whole minutes via hbAge and leaseLeft in tools.go (nine sites: ag lines, l lines, LEASE E exp=), docs/tools.md grammar updated. No liveness decision keys on sub-minute precision; sweeps bound ages to [0, agentTTL). Verification: unit tests pin the 0.9s vs 1.1s boundary that flaked; go test -race -count=10 x 2 concurrent lanes of internal/mcpclient = 20/20 green under load; bench A/B vs main baseline: tie at +0B, validity unchanged — the deliverable is determinism, not tokens.
